Pricing guide

What do wedding flowers actually cost?

The question everyone wants answered and almost no one publishes. Here are the budget bands we see most often across Australia — and what actually moves the number.

Intimate / minimal florals$1,500 – $3,000
Classic wedding florals$3,000 – $6,500
Full design with installations$6,500 – $15,000
Large-scale statement design$15,000+

Indicative bands for guidance only — confirm real figures before publishing.

Common questions

Wedding flower questions, answered

How much do wedding flowers cost in Australia?
Most Australian couples spend between $3,000 and $6,500 on wedding flowers, though intimate or minimal designs can start around $1,500 and full designs with suspended or arched installations commonly run past $15,000. The biggest drivers are the number of arrangements, whether you want installations, how far the blooms travel and whether your flowers are in season. Send one brief through Aisle & Stem and you'll get itemised proposals to compare rather than a single guess.
How far in advance should I book a wedding florist?
Nine to twelve months before the wedding is the comfortable window, and sought-after studios in Sydney and Melbourne are often booked further out than that for peak season — roughly October through April. If your date is closer than that, enquire anyway: florists hold different capacity, and a mid-week or off-season date opens up considerably more choice.
What's the difference between a florist and a floral designer?
A florist supplies and arranges flowers, and many do that beautifully. A floral designer starts from a creative concept for the whole event — the palette, the shapes, how the room is transformed and how the flowers work with your venue and styling. Design-led work generally carries a higher budget because it includes concepting, site visits, installation and bump-out.
Do you charge to find me a florist?
No. Enquiring through Aisle & Stem is free, and there's no obligation to book anyone we introduce you to. You only ever pay the florist you choose, directly.
How does the matching process work?
You send one brief — your date, location, style direction, what you need and your budget band. We match it to florists who cover your area, work in that style and are available on your day. They respond with their approach and pricing, and you compare and choose. Your request is handled through My Event Match, our event matching partner.
Can you help with events other than weddings?
Yes. Alongside weddings we work with event florists and floral designers on engagement parties, corporate events and brand activations, private celebrations, and sympathy and funeral flowers. Choose the event type in the enquiry form and we'll match accordingly.
Which locations do you cover?
We currently cover New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland and Western Australia, with dedicated city pages for Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth and growing coverage across Parramatta, Liverpool, Newcastle, Wollongong, the Gold Coast, the Sunshine Coast, Geelong and the Mornington Peninsula. If your location isn't listed yet, send your brief and we'll tell you which florists travel to you.
What if I don't know what flowers I want yet?
That's completely normal, and it's why the site is organised by style rather than by flower. Pick the direction that feels closest — Romantic Garden, Modern Minimal, Colourful, Native & Textural, White & Green or Sculptural — and choose “still deciding” in the form. A good florist will shape the rest with you.
